newsHighlights.title: Three areas with huge potential for Sino-US AI collaboration
newsHighlights.summary: Experts identify three promising areas where China and the US can work together on artificial intelligence despite their differences.
newsHighlights.translation: 专家指出，尽管存在分歧，中美在人工智能领域仍有三大潜力巨大的合作方向。

newsHighlights.title: UN chief calls for AI curbs, end to wars in his final assembly address
newsHighlights.summary: The UN secretary-general urged global rules to curb artificial intelligence risks in his final speech to the General Assembly.
newsHighlights.translation: 联合国秘书长在最后一次大会演讲中呼吁出台全球规则，以遏制人工智能风险。

newsHighlights.title: Responsible AI: China's policy and practice
newsHighlights.summary: China has built a policy framework for responsible AI that balances rapid innovation with safety and ethics.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国已建立起负责任的人工智能政策框架，在快速创新与安全伦理之间寻求平衡。

newsHighlights.title: Tax data reveals rapid growth in China's high-tech industries
newsHighlights.summary: Latest tax figures reveal that China's high-tech industries are growing rapidly, powered by heavy investment in research.
newsHighlights.translation: 最新税务数据显示，在研发投入的推动下，中国高新技术产业正快速增长。

newsHighlights.title: Pacific temperatures hit record El Nino levels, scientist says
newsHighlights.summary: A scientist says Pacific Ocean temperatures have reached record El Nino levels, making climate technology more urgent than ever.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位科学家表示，太平洋水温已达到厄尔尼诺现象的历史峰值，气候技术比以往任何时候都更紧迫。

quote.author: Andrew Ng
quote.translation: 人工智能就是新时代的电力。
quote.explanation: 吴恩达把AI比作电力：就像一百年前电力渗透到各行各业一样，人工智能正在成为一种基础性、通用性的技术，重塑所有产业。理解这一点，就能明白为何各国都在争夺AI发展与治理的话语权。

pattern.pattern: A and B can go beyond ... to do sth.（A和B可以超越……去做某事）
pattern.example: China and the US can go beyond their differences to build shared rules for artificial intelligence.
pattern.translation: 中美两国可以超越分歧，为人工智能制定共同的规则。
pattern.usage: go beyond 表示“超越、不止于”，后接名词或动名词；to do 为目的状语。常用于外交与科技评论文章中，表达“跨越障碍达成合作”的语义。也可写作 go beyond differences in ... （超越在……方面的分歧）。

grammar.title: 英语新闻标题中的被动语态（Passive Voice in News Headlines）
grammar.explanation: 英语新闻标题常省略助动词 be，用“过去分词 + (by...)”直接表示被动，突出动作的承受者与新闻事实。阅读时需补全 be 动词还原为完整句。正式报道正文中，当动作发出者不重要或不便提及时，也常用完整被动语态（be + 过去分词）。
examples: Be model patriots, youth urged (= Youth are urged to be model patriots).
AI curbs called for in the final assembly address (= AI curbs are called for in the final assembly address).

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第四个音节 -ra- 上：kə-læ-bə-REI-shn。开头的 co- 弱读为 /kə/，中间的 /l/ 和 /b/ 要清晰，词尾 -tion 读 /ʃn/ 而不是 /tʃən/。类似的重音模式还有 innovation /ˌɪnəˈveɪʃn/、governance 的重音在第一音节 /ˈɡʌvənəns/。
examples: Sino-US collaboration on artificial intelligence has huge potential.
Close collaboration between scientists helps mitigate technological risks.

reading.title: AI Needs Both Innovation and Rules
reading.content:
Artificial intelligence is moving faster than the rules meant to guide it. At the United Nations, the secretary-general used his final assembly address to call for curbs on unchecked AI, arguing that the technology must be governed before it governs us. His warning came as tax data revealed rapid growth in China's high-tech industries, where breakthroughs in chips and algorithms are driving new businesses forward.

Yet growth alone is not enough. Experts say there is huge potential for China and the United States to go beyond their differences and collaborate in at least three areas: public health, climate technology and safety standards. China has already built a policy framework for responsible AI that balances innovation with ethics, while both sides share an interest in mitigating risks such as misinformation.

With Pacific temperatures hitting record El Nino levels, smart climate models are needed more than ever. Shared technology, shared rules and shared responsibility may be the only way forward.
reading.translation:
人工智能的发展速度超过了本应约束它的规则。在联合国，秘书长在最后一次大会演讲中呼吁对不受约束的AI加以遏制，主张这项技术必须在“它治理我们”之前先被治理。他的警告发出之际，税务数据显示中国高新技术产业正快速增长，芯片与算法的突破不断催生新业务。

然而，仅有增长还不够。专家表示，中美两国超越分歧、至少在公共卫生、气候技术和安全标准三个领域开展合作，潜力巨大。中国已建立起负责任的AI政策框架，在创新与伦理之间寻求平衡，而双方在降低虚假信息等风险方面有着共同利益。

太平洋水温已达厄尔尼诺现象的历史峰值，智能气候模型比以往任何时候都更加需要。共享的技术、共享的规则与共享的责任，或许是唯一的出路。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 CGTN《UN chief calls for AI curbs, end to wars in his final assembly address》《Responsible AI: China's policy and practice》《Tax data reveals rapid growth in China's high-tech industries》《Pacific temperatures hit record El Nino levels, scientist says》及 China Daily《Three areas with huge potential for Sino-US AI collaboration》《China and US can go beyond differences》改写，仅供英语学习使用。
